entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow
comments: # The model-facing `workflow` tool: the model writes a plain-JS
# orchestration script (agent/pipeline/parallel/phase hooks) that runs
# on ctx.workflowEngine — the seam carried by dsh-workflow-worker-thread
# in the sibling L9 closure above, so inject [tools, workflowEngine,
# systemPrompt] is fully satisfied.  Where ralph loops one fixed
# fresh-agent pattern, this tool hands the ORCHESTRATION itself to the
# model.  Defaults kept: toolName "workflow", maxResultChars 50000.
# Collection is synchronous (the parent turn blocks until the run
# settles); top-level runs are recorded as durable tool-workflow/*
# events on the parent session log.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-code-runtime
comments: # DISABLED — abstract seam: dsh-code-runtime is the Service Definition
# for ctx.codeRuntime; its default export is the bare CodeRuntime class,
# which registers service "codeRuntime" with no run() of its own.
# Same rule as dsh-jobs / dsh-compaction / dsh-workflow: the concrete
# backend below subclasses it and registers the SAME service name, so
# mounting both duplicate-registers "codeRuntime" and fails the boot.
# Listed for closure visibility; the backend carries the runtime.

entries.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread
comments: # The shipped ctx.codeRuntime backend: each program runs in ONE fresh
# Node worker thread (TypeScript type-stripped host-side, bindings
# bridged over a hostile-peer-validated port, empty env, heap cap).
# Containment, not a security boundary — trust posture is
# bash-equivalent by design.  No config: every budget takes its schema
# default — computeMs 60000 busy-time (same 60s magnitude as the
# sandboxed bash timeout), maxWallMs 600000, maxOutputBytes 64 MiB,
# maxOldGenerationSizeMb 512.  Mounting the provider alone does NOT
# change the model's tool surface: the consumer is dsh-tools' Code
# Mode (`run_code`), gated by the tools config `mode` field, which
# stays "native" at this level — the seam is live for scoped
# presentAs("code") agents, the default presentation is unchanged.
